name: Infinite Repetition via Dual Offset
aliases: Hexagonal Honeycomb Repetition via Dual Offset Repetition
definition: A method to create a perfect honeycomb pattern by combining two separate rectangular repetitions that are offset from each other, using a boolean OR operation on their distance functions.
summary: Infinite Repetition via Dual Offset creates perfect interlocking hexagonal honeycombs by combining two offset rectangular grids, avoiding clipping artifacts and allowing per-column properties at higher computational cost.
